description: Implementation of AutoConditionLock class managing mutex locking and condition variable waiting with timeout support in Android.

classes.name: AutoConditionLock

classes.name: WaitableMutexWrapper

methods.description: Waits for a condition with optional timeout, then acquires the lock if the condition is met.
